prompt.alinti: Claude can't generate video. It can still edit yours. 🎬
Opus 5.5 only outputs text, so it writes your edit as code. Changing one shot means changing one line, and every render comes out identical.
Write one HTML scene that renders any frame at time t, then a Playwright capture loop.
Motion graphics: lower thirds and kinetic titles as HTML scenes. For longer explainers, ask for a Remotion or HyperFrames composition.
Claude writes the script and calls a TTS engine through an MCP connector. Ask for word timestamps so every beat lands on the voice.
Transcribe the raw footage first, let Claude cut from the text, and have it check its own render.
Playwright steps the scene frame by frame, ffmpeg stitches it into an H.264 MP4 and muxes in your audio.
Faces and animals render as rough shapes up close, so keep real footage for people. Space scenes tend to overexpose, so ask for real colors.
Physically accurate lighting. No bloom, no blown highlights.
Save this for your next edit. Follow for daily Claude tips, prompting tricks, and real workflows.
